title: Tamara V NDE 1083
content:
11 July 2002, we decided to make a tour on the motorbike. When returning home I closed my eyes for a moment because of the brightness of the Sun, we were driving about 50 kilometers per hour, suddenly my husband started cursing, the motorbike accelerated enormously and I did not have the time to open my eyes. It had happened in a flash, a bang, a few somersaults and there we were lying. I suddenly felt very peaceful and happy and felt I wanted to leave my body when suddenly someone or something told me, "Don't go yet, it is not your time, your children still need you." I felt someone take my hand and saw or knew that it was a woman all dressed in white and she made me feel very calm. The I opened my eyes, I was lying in the grass and looked towards the Sun that warmed my face, next to me there was a grasshopper that looked right at me, and I wanted to shout for joy, I felt one with everything, all is beauty, then I felt a needle in my hand and got very angry I had to stand up and take off my helmet, I had to go home to my kids then I was pressed on the ground and got a terrible pain in my leg and was totally conscious again. In the mean time police and ambulance had arrived and from their talk I understood that it was impossible we had survived this, also the policeman said,: "Gee, those two were very lucky" because at the same time of our accident someone died in a similar way also with a truck and a motorbike. I did not realize very well what had happened because I could not see my wounded leg, and thought I had just sprawled my ankle, when I heard the medics talk about Gent ( a mayor city in Belgium, translator note) and amputation. I first thought they were talking about my husband. Well, then we went into the ambulance, photos were taken, (a true nightmare) operation, intensive care, and blood. When later I inquired with my doctor what all the numbers meant (I had remembered them) he told me that I had lost half of my blood, and had to be glad that I was still alive. How it is possible that I remained conscious apart from the NDE I do not know, even the doctors do not understand and I ask myself no questions about this any longer. When the other day I was allowed to move and saw my husband I got a laughing fit, but really a very strong one, I lasted for two hours, and the nurses only worsened it when they asked what was wrong, because I didn't know , and still don't know.

arrival.other_being_detail: A woman all dressed in white who took her hand and calmed her.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: She opened her eyes in the grass; later felt pain in her leg and was 'totally conscious again.'

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Motorbike crash (somersaults; severe injury with major blood loss).

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: After the crash she felt peaceful and wanted to leave her body; then received a message ('Don't go yet...') and contact with a woman in white; then opened her eyes and returned to ordinary awareness with increasing physical pain.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: She reports remaining conscious during severe trauma and later recalled medical 'numbers' indicating she lost half her blood; also an intense two-hour laughing fit upon seeing her husband.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "Don't go yet, it is not your time, your children still need you."; "I felt one with everything, all is beauty"; "Gee, those two were very lucky"
